senses.gloss: सभ् SABH = सह् SAH, in pra-sabham.

सभाग्य sa-bhāgya, a. happy, fortunate (person);
 🞄-bhājana, n. [fr. sabhājaya] n. showing 🞄of honour, attention.

सभापति sabhā́-pati, m. lord or president 🞄of an assembly or council;
 -maṇḍapa, n. (?) 🞄assembly hall.
सभार्य sa-bhārya, a. accompanied by his wife.
सभोद्देश sabhā‿uddeśa, m. precincts of the 🞄cabin.
